text_simplified:
Raising children begins even before they are born, by choosing a righteous, pious wife who preserves her religion and aids her husband in obedience to his Lord and in raising children to be upright.
The Prophet ﷺ said: "A woman is married for four things: for her wealth, for her lineage, for her beauty, and for her religion; so succeed with the one of religion, may your hands be rubbed with dust" (Sahih al-Bukhari 5090).
